title: 第0021章人间烟火第0022章灶火长明
content_zh:
第0021章人间烟火“刀鱼小灶”的烟火，不再只是巷子里的一缕香气。
它成了风，成了雨，成了城市呼吸的一部分。
一年过去，七十二灶大阵如星辰般稳定，星火日夜不熄，地脉安宁，“厨渊”沉寂。可巴刀鱼知道，真正的“镇界”，不是靠星火封印，而是靠**人间烟火**——那千家万户灶台上升起的、带着油烟与笑声的、不完美却真实的火。
他不再奔波于七十二城。
他留在巷口，守着这口灶，等一个人。
等一个，愿意为所爱之人，烧第一道菜的人。
**清晨·巷口**
“小刀鱼·家常菜”的餐车停在“刀鱼小灶”对面。
男孩——巴小刀——正笨拙地刷锅。水花四溅，锅底还有焦痕。
“别急。”巴刀鱼站在门口，“洗锅，不是为了干净，是为了‘静心’。”
“哦。”巴小刀点头，动作放慢。
“你爷爷教你做饭了吗？”
“教了。”巴小刀低头，“可他说，他烧了七十年，才明白，做饭不是为了吃饱，是为了**等**。”
“等？”
“嗯。”巴小刀抬头，眼神清澈，“等一个人回家。等一句‘真香’。等一个，愿意吃我烧糊的饭的人。”
巴刀鱼笑了。
他知道，火，真的传下去了。
**上午·社区活动中心**
“百家灶”活动正在进行。
这不是比赛，不是表演。

是**分享**。
每家带一道菜，不管多简单，多难吃，只要是你亲手做的，就有人愿意吃。
老王来了，带了一碗“记忆鱼”，但这次，是他自己熬的汤。
张姨来了，带了一盘红烧肉，肉有点硬，可她说：“这是我儿子小时候最爱吃的。”
外卖小哥来了，带了一盒炒饭，蛋没打散，酱油放多了，可他说：“这是我妈教我的第一道菜。”
人们围坐，笑着吃，笑着吐槽，笑着流泪。
“你这饭，比我老婆烧的还糊！”
“可我吃得比米其林还香！”
娃娃鱼坐在角落，闭眼。
她听见了。
听见锅铲声，听见笑声，听见“再来一口”，听见“下次我做给你吃”。
她轻声道：“这才是‘镇界宴’的第五道。”
酸菜汤啃着一块焦得发黑的肉，含糊道：“啥第五道？”
“**人间烟火**。”她微笑，“不是菜，是‘人’。”
**午后·学校厨房**
巴刀鱼站在讲台上。
台下，是一群初中生。
“今天，不教你们做菜。”他说，“教你们，**为什么做饭**。”
content_en:
Chapter 0021 Human Fireworks The fireworks of "Swordfish Xiaozao" are no longer just a wisp of fragrance in the alley.
It became the wind, the rain, and became part of the city's breathing.
One year has passed, and the seventy-two stove array is as stable as the stars. The sparks are not extinguished day and night, the earth's veins are peaceful, and the "Cooking Abyss" is silent. But Basiliyu knows that the real "boundary" is not sealed by sparks, but by ** human fireworks** - the imperfect but real fire that rises on the stoves of thousands of households, bringing with it smoke and laughter.
He no longer traveled to the seventy-two cities.
He stayed at the entrance of the alley, guarding the stove, waiting for someone.
Wait for someone who is willing to cook the first dish for the one you love.
**Early morning·Alley**
The dining car of "Saury·Home Cooking" is parked opposite the "Saury Small Stove".
The boy - Ba Xiaodao - was washing the pot awkwardly. Water splashed everywhere and there were scorch marks on the bottom of the pot.
"Don't worry." Basio stood at the door, "Washing the pot is not for cleanliness, but for 'meditation'."
"Oh." Ba Xiaodao nodded and slowed down his movements.
"Did your grandpa teach you how to cook?"
"Taught me." Ba Xiaodao lowered his head, "But he said that after seventy years of cooking, he understood that cooking is not for food, but for sex and other things."
"Wait?"
"Yes." Ba Xiaodao raised his head with clear eyes, "Waiting for someone to come home. Waiting for someone to say 'it smells so good'. Waiting for someone to eat my burned rice."
The bastard fish smiled.
He knew that the fire had really spread.
**Morning Community Activity Center**
The "Hundred Kitchen Stoves" activity is ongoing.
This is not a competition, this is not a show.
It’s **share**.
Bring a dish to each family, no matter how simple or unpalatable it is, as long as it is made by you, someone will be willing to eat it.
Lao Wang came and brought a bowl of "memory fish", but this time, he made the soup himself.
Aunt Zhang came and brought a plate of braised pork. The meat was a bit hard, but she said, "This is my son's favorite food when he was a child."
The delivery boy came and brought a box of fried rice. The eggs were not broken and there was too much soy sauce, but he said, "This is the first dish my mother taught me."
People sat around, laughing, eating, laughing and complaining, laughing and crying.
"Your rice is even burnt than my wife's!"
“But my food tastes better than Michelin’s!”
The giant salamander sat in the corner, eyes closed.
She heard it.
Hear the sound of the spatula, hear the laughter, hear "One more bite", hear "I'll cook it for you next time".
She whispered: "This is the fifth course of the 'Realm Banquet'."
Sauerkraut Soup chewed on a piece of burnt black meat and said vaguely: "What's the fifth course?"
"**Human Fireworks**." She smiled, "It's not food, it's 'people'."
**Afternoon·School Kitchen**
Basio stands on the podium.
Under the stage were a group of junior high school students.
"Today, I won't teach you how to cook." He said, "I will teach you why you cook."
